description_en: Checks whether a MongoDB instance meets the conditions for data restoration
description_zh: 检查MongoDB实例是否满足数据恢复的条件
name: CheckRecoveryCondition

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the source instance to recover
parameters.name: source_db_instance

parameters.help_en:
The names of the databases to be restored. The value is a JSON array.
If you do not specify this parameter, all databases are restored by default
parameters.help_zh:
所需恢复的数据库名，格式为JSON数组。
如果不传入本参数，默认恢复所有数据库
parameters.name: database_names

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore the instance. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The value can be any point in time within the last seven days. The value must be earlier than the current time and later than the creation time of the instance.
You must specify either this parameter or the BackupId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例所需恢复的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

本参数可取值为7天内的任意时间，但是须早于当前时间，且晚于实例的创建时间。
本参数和BackupId参数两者中必须传入一项
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62172.html operation to query the backup ID.
You must specify either this parameter or the RestoreTime parameter.
This parameter is not supported for sharded cluster instances
parameters.help_zh:
备份ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62172.html接口查询备份ID。
本参数和RestoreTime参数两者中必须传入一项。
分片集群实例不支持传入本参数
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The area where the source instance resides.

This parameter is required when the backup recover type is rebuilding a deleted instance.
This parameter is required when the backup recover type is geo-redundancy cloning
parameters.help_zh:
源实例所在区域。

当备份恢复类型为已删除实例重建时，需要且必填
当备份恢复类型为异地备份克隆时，需要且必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The area where the backup set resides during geo-redundancy recover.

This parameter is required when the backup recover type is geo-redundancy cloning
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份恢复时，备份集所在区域。

当备份恢复类型为异地备份克隆时，需要且必填
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en:
The backup recover type. Valid values:

0: local backup recover
1: local point-in-time recover
2: backup recover of a deleted instance using a backup set
3: geo-redundancy backup recover using a backup set
parameters.help_zh:
备份恢复类型



0:  本地备份恢复
1:   本地时间点恢复
2:  已删除实例使用备份集备份恢复
3:  异地备份使用备份集备份恢复
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
replicate 
sharding

This parameter is required when the backup recover type is rebuilding a deleted instance.
This parameter is required when the backup recover type is geo-redundancy cloning
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
replicate 
sharding

当备份恢复类型为已删除实例重建时，需要且必填
当备份恢复类型为异地备份克隆时，需要且必填
parameters.name: instance_type

IsValid.description_en:
Indicates whether the restoration conditions are met. Valid values:
true: The conditions are met.
false: The conditions are not met
IsValid.description_zh:
是否满足恢复条件，取值说明：
true：满足条件。
false：不满足条件
